market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month around $102-$105 on May 5, 2026 with elevated volatility from US-Iran tensions and Strait of Hormuz risk. Reaching $110 (any 1-min candle high) only requires roughly +5-8% intraday spike during 26 remaining days. Given the geopolitical setup that already drove WTI above $105 earlier in the week, this is a coin-flip-to-likely outcome.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran de-escalation or large inventory builds could cap the upside
